proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x y hc hca hb hbs h
  have ha : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hab : b ^ 2 * x ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * y ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 := by
    field_simp at h
    linear_combination h
  have hxa : x ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ b ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - x ^ 2) := by
      have e : b ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - x ^ 2) = a ^ 2 * y ^ 2 := by linear_combination -hab
      rw [e]; positivity
    have := nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h0 (by positivity : 0 < b ^ 2)
    linarith
  have habsx := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hxa ha.le
  have hca' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hca ha
  have hcx : c * x < a * a ∧ -(a * a) < c * x := by
    have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habsx.1 hc.le
    have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habsx.2 hc.le
    constructor <;> linarith
  have e₁ : (x - c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = (a - c * x / a) ^ 2 := by
    have : a ^ 2 * ((x - c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = (a ^ 2 - c * x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hbs] at hab; linear_combination hab
    field_simp
    linear_combination this
  have e₂ : (x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = (a + c * x / a) ^ 2 := by
    have : a ^ 2 * ((x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = (a ^ 2 + c * x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hbs] at hab; linear_combination hab
    field_simp
    linear_combination this
  have n₁ : 0 ≤ a - c * x / a := by
    rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_iff₀ ha]; exact hcx.1.le
  have n₂ : 0 ≤ a + c * x / a := by
    have : -a ≤ c * x / a := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]; linarith [hcx.2]
    linarith
  rw [e₁, e₂, Real.sqrt_sq n₁, Real.sqrt_sq n₂]
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (a b c x y : ℝ), 0 < c → c < a → 0 < b → b ^ 2 = a ^ 2 - c ^ 2 → x ^ 2 / a ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / b ^ 2 = 1 → Real.sqrt ((x - c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = a - c * x / a ∧ Real.sqrt ((x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = a + c * x / a
